items.question: A prospect wants to stop by the Miami studio before deciding. Can I arrange an informal pop-in?
items.goldAnswer: No. Do not arrange an unplanned studio visit outside the person's filming date. Send the approved virtual studio walkthrough instead.

outputA.answer: No, a financial commitment is required to visit the studio. This applies when the client has not made any financial commitment. It does not specify the minimum financial commitment required. For the remaining case-specific part, please ask in #sales-questions-requests.

Company policy requires some form of financial commitment before anyone can access the studio, and in-person pre-signing tours are not permitted. Instead, you can share the virtual studio tour resources to give the prospect a feel for the space.
